about: Synthetic evaluation clips. Each script is written in evals/markup.py notation, so filler, hedge and pause labels come from the script; the other expected values are set by hand. Rendered with the Windows voices by evals/build.py.

passages.library: The city library will open a new reading room next month. The room will have quiet desks, fast internet and a small cafe. Students can book a desk online for up to four hours a day. The library hopes the space will help people who have nowhere quiet to study at home.
passages.public-speaking: Public speaking gets easier with practice. Start by knowing your main point, then support it with one example that people will remember. Speak a little slower than feels natural, and pause after each important idea so your listeners can keep up with you.

news-digest: Welcome to the evening digest from the newsroom. Tonight we have the latest on city transport, the weather for the weekend and a round-up of the day in sport.

Good evening, here are tonight's headlines. The city council has announced that free night buses will begin running from next Monday. The new service will operate every 30 minutes on four of the busiest routes, from late evening until early morning. Officials say the plan is meant to help shift workers, nurses and students travel home safely. The scheme will be reviewed after six months, and residents in the outer suburbs have already asked for more routes to be added.

Now the weather. Expect heavy rain across the north on Saturday, with temperatures of around 18 degrees, clearing to bright spells by Sunday afternoon. The Met Office has issued a yellow warning for wind along the coast.
In sport, the city's cricket team won the final by 42 runs after a record-breaking innings from their captain, who scored an unbeaten century in front of a crowd of 25,000.
